checks.summary: An opaque foreground shape covers at least 30% of a chart.
A slide holds so many content objects or so much text that it may be hard to read.
Several content objects with little text occupy only a small part of a slide.
A slide carries the watermark text box that an Aspose.Slides save without a license added; a licensed re-save keeps it.
A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
An empty placeholder is invisible in a slide show but shows its prompt text when the deck is edited.
An opaque foreground shape covers at least 80% of a content shape.
A shape extends beyond the slide boundaries.
A slide has no visible authored content.
A slide repeats the meaningful content and geometry of an earlier slide.
Text has a contrast below 3:1 with the solid fill or background behind it, so it is hard to read.
Laid-out text runs past a slide edge, where the slide cuts it off.
Laid-out text spills out of a shape that neither grows to fit it nor shrinks it on overflow.
Laid-out text runs into a table or chart, or an opaque shape in front of it covers the text.
A shape contains visible text smaller than 12 pt.

v2/slides/ops.description: The operation document of slides edit --ops. Every slide and shape target resolves against the presentation as it was before the first operation, so content inserted earlier in the batch cannot be targeted, and a target deleted earlier fails the operation. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing. The bare array of operations is accepted as the document with only its ops. Each operation field's x-readBack says whether it is state the operation writes and where a read reports it: a read result's schema URI with a JSON Pointer to the property that reports the field, where a pointer ending in a dictionary's additionalProperties is the entry named after the field; unread for state no read reports yet; position for state a read reports by position rather than by name, such as cell values; not-state for a selector, a source or a parameter of the action.

shapeName.description: The shape's name, which edit operations accept as shapeName; omitted when it has none.

kind.description: What the shape is: placeholder for any placeholder, then chart, table, audio, video, image, group, or shape for any other shape.

placeholder.description: The placeholder role, which set_text and the other shape operations accept as placeholder when it is one they name; omitted for a shape that is not a placeholder. Roles outside the listed ones are the engine's placeholder type in lower case.

geometry.description: The geometry of an autoshape, which insert_shape accepts as geometry; omitted for any other shape and for a geometry no operation draws.

altText.description: The shape's alternative text, which screen readers and exported PDFs carry.

text.description: The shape's text; omitted when it has none.

runs.description: The shape's text runs with their effective formatting; only with --content full, and omitted for a shape without text.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs of a text shape with their outline level and bullet; only with --content full, and omitted for a shape without text of its own.

fillColor.description: The solid fill color, as #RRGGBB: a table's when every cell has the same one; only with --content full, and omitted without one solid fill.

line.description: The solid outline color, as #RRGGBB: a table's when every cell border has the same one; only with --content full, and omitted without one solid outline.

rowCount.description: How many rows a table has; only for a table with --content full.

columnCount.description: How many columns a table has; only for a table with --content full.

values.description: A table's cell text by row; only for a table with --content full.

chart.description: A chart's kind, title and data; only for a chart with --content full.

rect.description: Where the shape is on the slide.

slideId.description: The stable slide id, which edit operations accept as slideId.

name.description: The slide's name; omitted when it has none.

layout.description: The name of the slide's layout; omitted when it has none.

title.description: The slide's title text; omitted when the slide has no title.

text.description: The text of each shape that has text, in shape order; only with --content text.

shapes.description: The slide's top-level shapes in z-order; empty with --content text.

notes.description: The speaker notes; with --content full or --notes, and omitted when the slide has none.

comments.description: The slide's comments; only with --content full.

background.description: The slide's own background; only with --content full, and omitted when the slide shows its layout's.

transition.description: The slide-show transition into the slide, kind none when it has none, as set_transition writes it; only with --content full.

footer.description: What the slide shows in its footer area; only with --content full.

contentTruncated.description: Whether the shared max-chars budget cut this slide's content. The budget covers title, text, runs, paragraphs, table cells, chart labels, footer, requested notes and comments, including repeated projections; re-read this slide with a larger budget for the omitted content.

slidesTextRunData.description: One text run with its effective formatting.

font.description: The font of the run's Latin text.

latinFont.description: The Latin font the run states itself, such as a theme font reference like +mn-lt; omitted when the run takes it from its paragraph, shape or theme.

eastAsianFont.description: The font of the run's Chinese, Japanese and Korean text.

color.description: The solid color the text is drawn in, stated or inherited, as #RRGGBB; omitted for text without a solid fill.

slidesTransitionData.description: The slide-show transition into a slide.

kind.description: The transition; omitted for a kind no operation sets.

durationMs.description: The transition duration in milliseconds; omitted when the slide states none.

v2/slides/render-result.description: Result of slides render: one image per rendered slide.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The rendered slides in presentation order.

dpi.description: The raster resolution used; omitted for SVG and when --width set the size.

width.description: The exact raster width in pixels --width asked for; omitted otherwise.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the published file.

v2/slides/search-result.description: Result of slides search: the matches in shape text and speaker notes.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

hits.description: The returned matches in slide order; the window tells whether more exist.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

slidesSearchHit.description: One match in a shape's text or a slide's speaker notes.

scope.description: Whether the match is in a shape's text or in the speaker notes.

shapeId.description: A positive identifier persisted within the hit slide; omitted for a match in the notes.

shapeName.description: The name of the matched shape; omitted for the notes and for a shape without a name.

text.description: The match with up to 100 characters of context on each side.

start.description: Where the match starts in the shape's or the notes' text, as a 0-based character offset.

length.description: How many characters the match spans.
